svg.title: Five Handoffs from Inquiry to Collected MSO Fee
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-intake-to-collected-service-fee; chart type: process_flow; title: Five Handoffs from Inquiry to Collected MSO Fee; subtitle: Evidence quality controls delivery; service contracts control compensation.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Counsel owns representation decisions and legal advice. The MSO performs contracted administrative work at fair-market fixed or cost-plus rates. Case milestones measure operations, not a percentage interest in legal fees or settlement proceeds.; caption: Maintain separate claimant, evidence, service-delivery, and invoice ledgers. A signed retainer is neither usable medical proof nor recognized MSO revenue.; stages: label: Raw inquiry; value: Capture provenance and contact permission before routing; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Capture source URL, campaign identifier, timestamp, seller-specific contact language, and TrustedForm certificate when available. Use authorized LexisNexis identity checks and restricted identity tokens; a certificate alone proves neither claimant identity nor complete contact eligibility.; label: Signed law-firm retainer; value: Counsel accepts representation after duplicate-retainer screening; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Route conflict questions, existing representation, and retainer execution to the law firm. Scrub duplicates against authorized firm records and claimant attestations; do not imply access to a universal retainer registry.; label: Usable EMR and pharmacy proof; value: Retrieve records through the applicable documented access route; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Validate patient identity, recipient, scope, and authority under 45 CFR 164.524 or 164.508 as applicable. Preserve source pages, pharmacy identifiers, service dates, and request receipts; log missing exposure or diagnosis evidence.; label: Deficiency-free accepted case; value: Counsel confirms completeness against the current evidence matrix; numeric value: 4.0; detail: An LLM may draft ICD-10 and exposure chronologies, but trained reviewers verify every material assertion against the record. Counsel determines legal sufficiency; a qualified clinician resolves clinical interpretation questions.; label: Collected MSO vendor fee; value: Match contracted service delivery to invoice and cleared payment; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Bill the law firm's operating account for administrative services, not client trust funds. Track ACH settlement, service credits, and replacement-window obligations separately from legal recoveries and claimant cohort counts.

text.title: Five Handoffs from Inquiry to Collected MSO Fee
text.tspan: Five Handoffs from Inquiry to Collected MSO Fee

circle.title: label: Raw inquiry; value: Capture provenance and contact permission before routing; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Capture source URL, campaign identifier, timestamp, seller-specific contact language, and TrustedForm certificate when available. Use authorized LexisNexis identity checks and restricted identity tokens; a certificate alone proves neither claimant identity nor complete contact eligibility.

text.title: Capture source URL, campaign identifier, timestamp, seller-specific contact language, and TrustedForm certificate when available. circle.title: label: Signed law-firm retainer; value: Counsel accepts representation after duplicate-retainer screening; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Route conflict questions, existing representation, and retainer execution to the law firm. Scrub duplicates against authorized firm records and claimant attestations; do not imply access to a universal retainer registry.

text.title: Route conflict questions, existing representation, and retainer execution to the law firm. Scrub duplicates against authorized firm records and claimant attestations; do not imply access to a universal retainer registry.

circle.title: label: Usable EMR and pharmacy proof; value: Retrieve records through the applicable documented access route; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Validate patient identity, recipient, scope, and authority under 45 CFR 164.524 or 164.508 as applicable. Preserve source pages, pharmacy identifiers, service dates, and request receipts; log missing exposure or diagnosis evidence.

Counsel determines legal sufficiency; a qualified clinician resolves clinical interpretation questions.
